summary: Zayo supports preserving and modernizing E-Rate to continue providing reliable, affordable, and secure connectivity to schools and libraries. Zayo appreciates the Commission's review of the program and strongly supports preserving Special Construction eligibility for extending fiber infrastructure to underserved communities.
